presets.name: Slapback
presets.description: One short tape echo, about 90 ms, for a vintage voice or guitar.

presets.name: Quarter echo
presets.description: A plain echo on each beat, fading over a few repeats.

presets.name: Dotted eighth
presets.description: The dotted-eighth echo that fills the gaps between notes.

presets.name: Ping-pong eighths
presets.description: Eighth notes bouncing between the sides.

presets.name: Swung ping-pong
presets.description: Ping-pong with the right side swung.

presets.name: Tape echo
presets.description: Three-sixteenth repeats that darken and waver like tape.

presets.name: Analog bucket
presets.description: Dark, soft repeats from a small analog delay.

presets.name: Dub space
presets.description: Long feedback, thinning and darkening, with wobble: the dub throw.

presets.name: Vocal throw
presets.description: Echoes that wait for the singer to stop.

presets.name: Wide double
presets.description: Two short delays, a different one on each side, without repeats: a doubled, wider sound.

presets.name: Mid-side space
presets.description: On stereo sources, the centre echoes on the beat and the sides on the dotted beat: a wide, moving space.

presets.name: Shimmer drift
presets.description: Slow modulation on long repeats for pads.

presets.name: Telephone repeats
presets.description: Narrow, filtered echoes, like through a phone.

presets.name: Build to infinity
presets.description: Feedback near the top; freeze it to hold the last bar.

presets.name: Short room
presets.description: A few quick, soft repeats that read as a small room.
